race.comment: ALL TOO ROSEY (9) first two runs had merit when finishing in the minor money in similar company. Dropped in class with a below-par sixth over 1400m at Tabulam. Complete mystery last start and the senior rider hops on today. Capable of running a bold race. GLAM (1) settled back and failed to get into the contest second up with a struggling seventh over 1200m at the Gold Coast. Finds an easier race with a host of gear changes. Well placed with the 3kg claimer aboard. VETOED (5) deep into the campaign and struggling to break through. Covered ground in the run and failed to get into the contest with a dismal seventh over 1310m at this track. Finds a suitable race and stays in the mix. GOLD PUMA (2) sharp improver at the big odds with a fighting second to Star Of Winston over 1420m at Grafton. Claim helps and her lone victory here. Respect.
